records.name: Included roster, explicit TBA entries, separate Heaven and all quest definitions
Family binds same departure, respects new Heaven/order, grants distinct rewards
Fresh returned character instances start a new quest without reusing rewards
Soldier penalty every second retained shared crossing, separate pair reward
Listener transforms on third shared crossing, keeps origin and coexists with Poet
Meal is once per shared boarding, includes Cook reduction and can expire Cook
Blacksmith protects Merchant Anger, enforces order and grants only one Sword
Mason leaves last including Polongs; capacity can be used before boarding and expires
Priest +1 memory or purification trade-off, once per boarding and save/reload
Heracles toll, Cerberus encounter, second-stage wishes and Golden Apple stacking
Odysseus branches commit once, preserve pending choice on load, handle empty hand/boat
Sword removal has no expiry damage, spread, memory or fare reward
Unlimited memories, overflow cannot be spent, full fog does not block Wraiths
Moly suppresses scheduled arrivals without increasing level; Nobody blocks fog only
Polong encounter levels, next variant and forced Po Nak overload
Po Mued concealment hides route/cost through review, Foresight overrides it
Po Due timing and Haven guarantee preserve already visible offers
Po Luem skips boarding round then creates a saved discard choice; empowered loss is deterministic
Level-five spread conserves origin, spares family and fails participant quests
Only original normally delivered Po Long pays Light; fatal damage stops rewards
Save validation rejects old versions, broken origins, duplicated IDs and wrong pending choices
128 seeded all-system runs: deterministic replay, immutable transitions and every-state save round trips

limitation: Agent automated scenarios and seeded runs. Not human playtesting or balance evidence.
